title: Count Words
problem: Read one line of text made of words separated by single spaces. Print how many words it has. For example, the quick brown fox gives 4.
starter_code:
# Read one line of words separated by spaces.
# Print how many words there are.

# Write your code here

hidden.input: one two three four five six
to be or not to be that is the question

hints.1: Words are separated by spaces, so counting the separators gives a number that is off by one. Think about a way to cut the line into its words instead.
hints.2: Text has a method that splits it into a list of words. The built-in len() tells you how many items a list has.

failure_explanation: Count the words, not the spaces: a line with one word has no spaces at all, and a line always has one more word than it has gaps. Splitting the line into a list of words and counting the list avoids the off-by-one. Print only the number.
